the combination of P2P technology with OSGi technology is a promising approach to extend home networks to multi-server home environments for advanced applications.

the extension of OSGi home networks with peer-to-peer communication and management for the creation of virtual home environments.
the integration of peer-to-peer technology into OSGi server-based home networks.

extending the capabilities of OSGi server-based home networks by the integration of JXTA P2P communication and security mechanisms to enable multi-server home environments for advanced home applications.
